description: This file contains FastAPI endpoint definitions, Pydantic models, and test cases for API validation and behavior, focusing on dependency injection with Depends and testing multiple request scenarios.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Pydantic model representing an item with a single string data field.

methods.name: duplicate_dependency(item: Item)
methods.description: A dependency function that returns the provided item, used for dependency injection.

methods.name: dependency(item2: Item)
methods.description: Another dependency function returning the provided item, used for injection.

methods.name: sub_duplicate_dependency( item: Item, sub_item: Item = Depends(duplicate_dependency) )
methods.description: A dependency that depends on duplicate_dependency and returns a list of items.

methods.name: with_duplicates(item: Item, item2: Item = Depends(duplicate_dependency))
methods.description: API endpoint handling POST requests with duplicate dependencies, returning a list of items.

methods.name: no_duplicates(item: Item, item2: Item = Depends(dependency))
methods.description: API endpoint handling POST requests with different dependencies, returning a list of items.

methods.name: no_duplicates_sub( item: Item, sub_items: list[Item] = Depends(sub_duplicate_dependency) )
methods.description: API endpoint using sub_dependency, which depends on another dependency, returning a list.

methods.name: test_no_duplicates_invalid()
methods.description: Test case for verifying validation failure when required fields are missing.

methods.name: test_no_duplicates()
methods.description: Test case for successful POST request to /no-duplicates endpoint.

methods.name: test_duplicates()
methods.description: Test case for successful POST request to /with-duplicates endpoint.

methods.name: test_sub_duplicates()
methods.description: Test case for POST request to /with-duplicates-sub endpoint with nested items.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema()
methods.description: Test case checking the correctness of the OpenAPI schema JSON.

ctags.name: no_duplicates
ctags.pattern: /^async def no_duplicates(item: Item, item2: Item = Depends(dependency)):$/

ctags.name: with_duplicates
ctags.pattern: /^async def with_duplicates(item: Item, item2: Item = Depends(duplicate_dependency)):$/
